title: Number Quest Unit 5 · The Sky Wires (Pro)

items.q: A line passes through (1, 2) and (5, 8). What is its slope?
misconceptions: divided the run by the rise
correct
found the rise and stopped
divided the y of one point by its x
items.why: The rise is 8 − 2 = 6 and the run is 5 − 1 = 4. Slope is rise over run: 6/4 = 3/2.

items.q: A drone climbs at a steady rate: 15 meters in 6 seconds. Its graph is a line through (0, 0). What is the slope of the line?
misconceptions: divided the seconds by the meters
subtracted the seconds from the meters
correct
multiplied the two numbers
items.why: The slope is the unit rate: 15 meters ÷ 6 seconds = 2.5 meters each second. Check: 2.5 × 6 = 15.

items.q: A line passes through (−2, 4) and (2, −4). What is its slope?
misconceptions: dropped the negative sign of the rise
divided the run by the rise
added the y-values instead of subtracting them
correct
items.why: The rise is −4 − 4 = −8 and the run is 2 − (−2) = 4. Slope is −8/4 = −2: the line goes down 2 for each step across.

items.q: A table has x = 0, 1, 2, 3 and y = 5, 8, 11, 14. Which rule gives y?
misconceptions: swapped the start value and the rate of change
left out the start value
correct
used a change of 1 for each step
items.why: When x is 0, y is 5, so the rule starts at 5. Each step adds 3, so the slope is 3: y = 3x + 5. Check: 3 × 3 + 5 = 14.

items.q: A candle is 20 cm tall and burns down 2 cm each hour. Which rule gives its height h after t hours?
misconceptions: correct
added the change instead of subtracting it
swapped the start height and the change
subtracted the two numbers before using the hours
items.why: The candle starts at 20 cm, and each hour takes away 2 cm, so after t hours it has lost 2t. The rule is h = 20 − 2t. After 3 hours: 20 − 6 = 14 cm.

items.q: A line passes through (2, 7) and (4, 11). What is its y-intercept?
misconceptions: gave the slope instead of the y-intercept
correct
stepped back one unit instead of two
gave the y-value of the first point
items.why: The slope is (11 − 7)/(4 − 2) = 2. From (2, 7), go back 2 steps to x = 0: 7 − 2 × 2 = 3. The rule is y = 2x + 3.

misconceptions: multiplied only the x by 3
correct
subtracted 6 from the right side instead of adding it
added x to the left side instead of subtracting it
items.why: Multiply out: 3x − 6 = x + 4. Subtract x: 2x − 6 = 4. Add 6: 2x = 10, so x = 5. Check: 3 × 3 = 9 and 5 + 4 = 9.

items.q: At which point do the lines y = 3x − 1 and y = x + 5 meet?
misconceptions: wrote the y-value first
subtracted 1 from 5 instead of adding it
added 1 instead of subtracting it to find y
correct
items.why: Set the rules equal: 3x − 1 = x + 5, so 2x = 6 and x = 3. Then y = 3 + 5 = 8. The point (3, 8) is on both lines: 3 × 3 − 1 = 8.

misconceptions: decided that equal slopes always mean no solution
assumed every equation has one solution
counted the two sides of the equation
correct
items.why: Multiply out the right side: 2(2x + 3) = 4x + 6. Both sides are the same expression, so the equation is true for every value of x.
